sloka: कैलास शिखर आवासी यक्षैर् बहुभिर् आवृतः ।सुमहत् कदनम् कृत्वा वश्यस् ते धनदः कृतः ॥६-७-४॥।।
transliteration: kailāsa śikhara āvāsī yakṣair bahubhir āvṛtaḥ ।sumahat kadanam kṛtvā vaśyas te dhanadaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥6-7-4॥।।

translations.english: "Oh king, (our army is equipped with) iron bars, javelins, double edged swords, spears, three pointed weapons, ploughs etc."
